title: strings.json
description: ALL runtime UI labels (web/pdf/cli/sheet), phases, recurrent display names+descs, dev fallback (plan §2.2). Translator-owned. Keys are STABLE across locales; only values change. UI strings are the ONLY class allowed to fall back (→ locale.fallback → hard error). The copy-to-clipboard JSON payload keys (aplicaciones/desarrollos/ia_addons/totales.*) are a MACHINE CONTRACT and are NOT in this file.

web.description: Web-template UI strings. Placeholders like {cliente} allowed.

sheet.description: Spreadsheet-template labels (generate_spreadsheet_template.py). INTERNAL chrome: English in every locale, carried by the `en` pack only and inherited by the rest through the display-string fallback chain — hence optional here, like `params`. Its keys are NOT required here: a pack may legitimately declare only the client-facing ones (see CLIENT_FACING_SHEET_KEYS) and inherit the rest. validate_locale.check_reference_carries_inherited enforces the full set on the reference pack, which is where the guarantee actually belongs.

params.description: Parameters-sheet chrome (generate_spreadsheet_template.build_params). The workbook is an INTERNAL tool, so this block is English in every locale: only the `en` pack carries it and the rest inherit through the display-string fallback chain. Optional here for exactly that reason.

hdr.description: [label, value, description, key]. Index 3 names the KEY column and index 1 the VALUE column: that is the contract with proposal_data.sheet_overrides, pinned by tests/params_sheet_contract_smoke.py. Change it here and the parser silently reads the human labels as technical keys.

groups.description: group id -> section header shown on the sheet.

descs.description: technical key -> what it does (column C).

recurrent_names.description: Display name per recurrent id (registry recurrent_lines). Used on the =ODOO.LIST fallback path only.

recurrent_descs.description: Desc per recurrent id. NOTE (B1, RESOLVED by the Indaws->Dynapps rebrand): the live path looks desc up by the SHEET TITLE verbatim; pre-rebrand the es sheet emitted 'Indaws Cloud' so the lookup MISSED → desc=''; post-rebrand it emits 'Dyn Cloud', which matches, so the lookup HITS. These descs apply only on the =ODOO.LIST fallback path.

dev_descriptions.description: Per-dev-id prose (registry devs ids). proposal_data matches the sheet dev display name to a dev id (accent-normalized, parenthetical-tolerant) via app_registry.devs[*].es_display_name; dev_fallback used when no id matches.

dev_fallback.description: Fallback dev description when no dev_id matches. es='Desarrollo a medida para cubrir necesidades específicas de tu negocio.'

cli.description: CLI stdout strings for sibling scripts.

apps.description: App-catalog UI strings (e.g. default_outcome when an app has no outcome).

phase_flow.description: Proposal phase-flow labels/durations: weeks ('{n} weeks'), in_parallel, nums.

ia.description: AI value-add catalog display names/descriptions keyed by id (exclusive/addons/poc).

fill.description: fill_spreadsheet.py Gantt/legend labels (task names, legend header + full/short legend entries). Keys stable across locales.

sections.description: Free-form section labels used by the proposal/spreadsheet flow. Keys stable across locales.
